import numpy as np

from torch import nn

x_np, y_np = make_sensor(600, seed=7)

    nn.Conv1d(16, 32, 5, padding=2), nn.ReLU(), nn.AdaptiveMaxPool1d(1),
    nn.Flatten(), nn.Linear(32, 2))
opt = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.003)
